steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and finely grate the cooked carrot; squeeze out any excess moisture with a clean cloth.
Finely chop the pitted dates, then mash them with a fork until a rough paste forms.
In a large bowl, mix the oat flour, ground flaxseed, cinnamon, and ground ginger together.
Add the date paste, grated carrot, coconut milk, and coconut oil to the bowl; stir until a firm dough forms.
Roll the dough into 18 balls of about 2 cm and place them on the prepared baking sheet.
Flatten each ball slightly with the palm of your hand to form small rounds.
Bake for 16 to 18 minutes, until firm to the touch and lightly golden on the bottom.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes before serving. Store in an airtight container for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
